mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 9.0% in a 3-month window, it signals worsening labor market conditions and economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and INDPRO decline.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-2008 financial crisis regime, a rising inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an impending monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances during the post-2008 financial crisis regime despite rising CPIAUCSL and low FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 600.0 thousand units, it signals a strong housing market and economic expansion, causing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 600.0.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 3.0% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 2.0%, the market anticipates a monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS < 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates weakening labor market conditions, which typically precedes economic slowdown and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines.
